title: Mountains, Waters and Sesshin, Part 1
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett's talk emphasizes the importance of embracing the present moment without attachment or preconception, much like the fluid and dynamic nature of a mountain. This "mountain walking" practice encourages practitioners to let go of limitations and instead embody solidity and freedom, allowing for direct experience and understanding that transcends conceptual views. By approaching their practice with seriousness, relaxation, and openness, individuals can tap into the reality of the present moment and find guidance in Dogen's teachings.
topics: Dogen's "San Sui Kyo" text ("Mountains and Waters Sutra")
